_about: For each diagnostic, whether the property is general, restricted or absent for English common nouns and for adjectives (including fused-head adjectives and the article's quantificational-adjective controls). Every non-null cell carries its source; null means no source was located and is rendered as ? in the register. Built 2026-09-17 after a first hand-written version proved wrong in eight cells; do not fill a cell without a source.

number_inflection.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Inflection row: 'Number and genitive'
number_inflection.adjective_source: CGEL p. 418: 'the rich and the very poor are plural NPs with no inflectional plural marking on the head'

genitive_marking.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Inflection row
genitive_marking.note: no CGEL statement about genitive marking on adjectives located

dependent_det.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Argument / Det functions: 'genitive and restricted plain Det'
dependent_det.adjective_source: article §5.2: Det realized by NP or PP

external_determination.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Accepts determination: 'Broad contrasts'
external_determination.adjective_source: CGEL pp. 415-418, fused modifier-heads: 'The NPs are determined by the definite article' (p. 417: the rich, the very poor); ordinals with a (p. 416: a second)

independent_argument.adjective_source: CGEL pp. 415-418 (fused modifier-heads); quantifier supplement attestations 'numerous were injured', 'countless were left in floods of tears'

independent_partitive.common_noun_source: CGEL pp. 349-350 (lot, number, couple with partitive obliques), cited in the article
independent_partitive.adjective_source: CGEL p. 416 n. 42: 'taking a partitive complement (e.g. the biggest of them)'; supplement 'numerous of them', 'multiple of the fast casual eateries'

number_agreement.common_noun_source: CGEL pp. 349-350, 411-412: quantificational lot number-transparent, cited in the article
number_agreement.note: no statement located for fused-head adjectives (the best of them were)

dependent_internal_mod.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Modifier / adjunct functions: 'dog houses'

internal_mod_admission.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Internal modification: 'Productive AdjP and nominal premodifiers ... relatives'
internal_mod_admission.adjective_source: CGEL p. 548: 'The use of adverbs as modifiers in AdjP structure is described in §7.2'

peripheral_mod_admission.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Peripheral modifiers: 'only the book'
peripheral_mod_admission.note: the peripheral/internal distinction is defined over NP structure; not applied to AdjP

predicative_complement.common_noun_source: CGEL Ch. 4 §5, predicative complements realized by NPs (page not located in this pass)

relative_postmod_admission.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Internal modification: 'relatives'
relative_postmod_admission.adjective_source: supplement attestation 'think about various who had done it'; CGEL p. 418 post-head modifier in a fused AdjP 'the pure in heart' ('very rare')

existential_displaced_subject.common_noun_source: CGEL Ch. 16 §6.2, the existential construction, p. 1392
existential_displaced_subject.adjective_source: supplement attestations 'there are numerous', 'In fact, there are countless'

degree_modifier_adj.common_noun_source: CGEL pp. 551-552: a great deal better, cited in the article
degree_modifier_adj.adjective_source: CGEL p. 548: modifiers in AdjP structure are adverbs (§7.2); no adjective modifiers of adjectives described

grade_inflection.common_noun_source: article Table 2, common-noun column, Inflection row lists number and genitive only
grade_inflection.adjective_source: CGEL p. 1672 (inflectional suffixes ·er and ·est); Ch. 13 from p. 1100

predeterminer_mod.common_noun_source: CGEL p. 385 n. 25: fractions 'expressed by nouns or NPs in predeterminer modifier function'
predeterminer_mod.note: the p. 435 pair (degree such, exclamative what) is reanalysed in the article's §3.1 as determinatives with Det and predeterminer functions, beside many in many a (adopted 2026-09-17, revised the same day from 'restricted determinatives with complex forms'); no adjective source remains

coordination_marker.note: both/either/neither are determinatives; no statement about nouns or adjectives

fused_head.note: an analysis, not a lexical property; not rated
